section_summary: This section contains diplomatic and military records concerning Japanese territorial questions, including historical maps of the Bonin Islands and communications between President Truman and Premier Stalin regarding Kurile Islands air bases. It also includes a formal petition from the Hokkaido Prefectural Assembly forwarded to General Douglas MacArthur requesting the return of Habomai, Etorofu, and Kunashiri from Soviet occupation. The remainder comprises an extensive October 1947 briefing compilation from Headquarters Ryukyus Command (RYKOM) reviewing troop strengths, technical service operations, surplus property, and the 1945 Battle of Okinawa.

subfiles.about: Historical maps of the Bonin Islands prepared during Tokugawa Shogunate expeditions in 1675 and 1861.
subfiles.summary: Illustrations of historical maps of the Bonin Islands, including Haha-jima, drawn during Tokugawa Shogunate expeditions in 1675 and 1861.
subfiles.title: Maps of the Bonin Islands

subfiles.about: President Truman's response to Generalissimo Stalin regarding American requests for landing rights in the Kurile Islands.
subfiles.summary: President Truman clarifies to Stalin that U.S. requests for emergency and commercial landing rights in the Kuriles support occupation cooperation without challenging Soviet territorial claims.
subfiles.title: President Truman to Generalissimo Stalin on Kurile Islands Landing Rights

subfiles.about: Transmittal despatch forwarding a Japanese petition requesting the return of Habomai, Etorofu, and Kunashiri islands.
subfiles.summary: US POLAD Tokyo transmits a petition addressed to General MacArthur from the Hokkaido Prefectural Assembly requesting the return of adjacent northern islands.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1204: Forwarding Petition for Restoration of Islands Adjacent to Hokkaido

subfiles.about: Cover sheet for the enclosed petition forwarded with Despatch No. 1204.
subfiles.summary: Cover sheet for enclosure to Despatch 1204 regarding the petition for restoration of islands adjacent to Hokkaido.
subfiles.title: Enclosure Cover Sheet to Despatch No. 1204

subfiles.about: Petition from the Hokkaido Prefectural Assembly requesting General MacArthur to secure the return of Soviet-occupied northern islands to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Hokkaido Prefectural Assembly petitions General Douglas MacArthur for the return of the Habomai Islands, Etorofu, and Kunashiri, arguing they are historic Japanese territories rather than areas taken by aggression. The petition emphasizes the loss of vital fishing grounds, economic hardship, and the separation of thousands of displaced inhabitants under Soviet military occupation. Both English translation and original Japanese text are included.
subfiles.title: Petition for the Return of Habomai Islands and the Islands of Etorofu and Kunashiri

subfiles.about: State Department internal document routing and file sheet for decimal file 894.014.
subfiles.summary: Document file sheet for State Department decimal file 894.014 referencing Bond and Mr. Niles.
subfiles.title: State Department Document File Sheet for File 894.014

subfiles.about: Comprehensive briefing book and technical service reports on Ryukyus Command military strength, operations, surplus disposal, and the Battle of Okinawa.
subfiles.summary: Headquarters Ryukyus Command compiled this comprehensive briefing volume in October 1947 for visiting dignitaries, detailing administrative, logistics, and troop operations on Okinawa. It includes command rosters, military and civilian personnel statistics, dependent housing reports, and technical service summaries for Chemical, Engineer, Medical, Ordnance, Quartermaster, Signal, and Transportation units. The document also provides surplus property disposal figures and reproduces a historical monograph on the 1945 Battle of Okinawa.
subfiles.title: Ryukyus Command VIP Information Book and Staff Reports
